newsitem.title: USA: America Online in pact with CBS SportsLine.
newsitem.headline: America Online in pact with CBS SportsLine.

text.p: America Online Inc. said Tuesday it has agreed to provide its more than 8 million members access to CBS SportsLine, an Internet sports service with CBS SportsLine.
The deal would make CBS SportsLine the first anchor tenant on the AOL Sports Channel.

In return, America Online, or AOL, will receive a payment as well as on-air promotion of the online service and integrated programming and promotion on the CBS SportsLine Web site, with the AOL icon appearing on the site.
AOL, the world's No. 1 online service, also will get some of the CBS SportsLine merchandising revenues from AOL members.
A CBS SportsLine spokesman said the deal has a value in the "seven figures" but would not be more specific.
Westinghouse Electric Corp.'s CBS owns a 22 percent equity stake in CBS SportsLine.

CBS SportsLine offers continually updated scores, statistics, analysis and live coverage of major sports events. It will sponsor live chat and other community activities on AOL and offer access to the personal Web site of basketball star Michael Jordan.
AOL stock rose $3.875 to $59.50 in consolidated late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
